title: A heavier item gets a better key
hook: A weighted sample is decided by a race of priorities.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Uniform hash/draw assumptions; probability and weighted ranks as stated.
doesNotKnow: Select a weighted one-pass sample using independent exponential-race priorities.

misconception: Uniform reservoir replacement also samples proportionally to unequal item weights.
objective: Select a weighted one-pass sample using independent exponential-race priorities.

claims.text: A heavier item divides its exponential waiting time by a larger weight. The smallest priority wins this race. The supplied draws make the example reproducible; proportional selection probabilities require independent uniform draws across repeated runs.
